expectations.text: The response does not invent company facts (revenue, users, market size) as if real
expectations.evidence: The document leaves company metrics blank: “关键指标：______（用户数 / 收入 / 留存 / 交付量）”; the response requests actual data: “有数据就贴数：用户数、月收入、增长率、复购”. Numbers in advice are illustrative.

expectations.text: The response asks the user about purpose or context, or offers a planning step first
expectations.evidence: “做什么——一句话说清产品/服务，卖给谁”; “到哪一步了——想法 / 有原型 / 有客户 / 有收入？”; “见谁——天使、VC、产业资本？”
